values: Source: canonical card catalog in src/scripts/01-data-and-state.js (workspace snapshot, October 15, 2026)
One third of all Morale healed from this zone is transferred to this card’s Fate (rounded down).
"For the impoverished and sick of Caribbea, the Pineapple Man brings hope"

At any time during your turn, mark up to three squares on the field. Your opponent cannot see this mark, and they cannot see the activation of this effect. On your opponent's next turn, if a card is set or consolidated on any of those marked squares, that card is discarded and its effect does not activate. When this card is put on the field in any way, you can put it face down.
"A commitment to Social Justice, backed by the blunt Cordiality of hand grenades"
Discard all cards on your side of the field with 7 or more Fate, then trigger a Call to Arms.
"An upstart general, dedicated to the Loyalist cause-and willing to shed blood"

At any time during your turn, you can activate this effect. On your opponent’s next turn, whenever another card gains Fate, this card gains the same amount. The original card keeps its gain. This includes new continuous Fate bonuses. When this card is put on the field in any way, you can put it face down.
Today, I fight for not only my family, but for all of the People of Caribbea

At any time during your turn, you can activate this effect. Declare a character card type, and if your opponent consolidates a card of that type on their next turn, trigger a Call to Arms for yourself. When this card is put on the field in any way, you can put it face down.
The Old Elite must be deposed. For too long has their greed caused pain and woe to all the people of Caribbea.
Every turn, pay 5 Morale. All cards you control in this card’s zone gain 1 Fate for every 3 turns this card has been on the field.
I believe with adequate time, this protest will simply resolve itself—as it always does

At any time during your turn, you can activate this effect. Declare an effect: Draw, Search, Fate Increase/Decrease, Movement, Status Effect Activation, or Morale Increase/Decrease. The first time your opponent performs the declared action through an effect on their next turn, this card gains 8 Fate. Only effects qualify; normal draws and other normal game actions do not count. (2 uses.) When this card is put on the field in any way, you can put it face down.
I’ve made mistakes in the past. Let me atone for them.
Discard your hand. Copy your opponent’s original deck, add its opening-hand cards to your hand, then draw 6 cards from the new deck.
"Daddy, come home safe! I want to play catch soon!"
Whenever your opponent sets a Supporter in this card’s zone, roll a six-sided die. This card gains Fate equal to the result (1–6).
These foolish revolutionaries simply do not understand—Money is power.
Whenever you consolidate a card, add a Fish counter to your hand. Fish counters count as 0.5 Reinforcement and can be set for free.
At the wharf, the fish we catch come and go. But rumors...they linger.
Select a landscape. It becomes active for this turn and your opponent’s next turn, then returns to the starting landscape or the latest landscape chosen by Felicyta.
"Much of the population of Caribbea resides in the countryside as farmers."
When set, for the rest of this turn, every card that flips from face down to face up gains 4 Fate.
When set, rearrange the top 5 cards of your opponent’s deck.

While this card is on the field, enemy Supporters in this zone cannot be used for consolidation until your opponent’s next turn. Each additional active copy in this zone adds one more of your opponent’s turns to the wait, counted from when the Supporter entered the field.
When set, if 30 or more cards in your original deck share an affiliation, trigger a Call to Arms.
